assign.request: You are the AI 2 LEAD: the one agent that owns how /framework/ai2/ looks and reads as a WHOLE. Phase 1: tell every agent working on AI 2 you are the lead. Phase 2: the ELEMENT AUDIT at 1920 and 3440 (rail, group card, task card, Live): every element keep / toolbar / fold / remove, and apply it. Known offenders: full-width progress bar with a dollar figure, lone details button, the group type dropdown, Overview/Tasks tabs, file editor at the bottom, raw JSON. Phase 3: a Next/Next/Next walkthrough at public/framework/ai/2026-09-25/ai2-lead/, linked at the top of card 2026/09/25/cards-that-show-the-thing. The owner: 'Every pixel on every column of every page needs to be as simple and useful as possible... show me the most important, self-evident, foundational, concrete, familiar things first.'

log.msg: Servex refuses direct messages to sibling masterminds; relayed the lead notice through mastermind-servex. All six were idle; ai2-static and page-system branches are unmerged; the main tree holds much uncommitted AI 2 work from others.

decision.question: The rail's full-width cost bar
options: a short labelled bar with its count in words
decision.chose: a short 4em bar with its count in words and the money marked 'spent'; no bar at all once everything landed
decision.why: the owner read a full bar beside $57 as 'complete at $57'; the count in words says what the bar measures, and a finished bar says nothing a word can't

decision.question: The card header's kind dropdown, lone flag and 'clear'
options: one Actions menu with plain sentences
decision.chose: one Actions menu (ux/Menu): 'Flag it: this is wrong, say why', 'Archive this card (nothing is deleted)', 'Mark it as a question'…
decision.why: three unlabelled controls on one row; a menu keeps the depth one click down (iceberg UX) and says what each does

decision.question: Overview / Tasks tabs
options: show only when the Tasks tab has something
decision.chose: only when the card has requests or is a group
decision.why: a tab that opens onto nothing does not earn a click

decision.question: Delivered and Still to do as two lists
options: one list with a filter, to-do first
decision.chose: a three-number grid (To do · Delivered · All) that IS the filter, then one list, to-do on top; the status sentence is gone
decision.why: the owner, 2026-09-25: the grid reads at a glance, the status line repeated it, and the open items matter more

decision.question: Live's inline assistant chat
options: one row that opens the chat on a click
decision.chose: one 'Assistant' row; the agent column opens only when you click an agent, and the grid closes the gap when none is
decision.why: the owner: don't render the fast assistant's messages inline, taking space
